attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Ohio state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per Ohio Rev. Code § 5747.02: tax = max(AGI - $0 std ded, 0) x 3.5%. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.computed_state_tax = 0; set result.computed_state_taxable_income = 0; add " Ohio Tax Calculation (top marginal 3.5%)" to job.audit_trail; set result.oh_military_retirement_deduction = 0.0; if result.state_calc_resident_status is equal to "full_year" then { set result.oh_military_retirement_deduction = result.military_retirement_income; } endif; add " OH Schedule of Adjustments line 34 uniformed services retirement income: $" + result.oh_military_retirement_deduction to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " Ohio Tax Calculation (top marginal 3.5%)" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 cvd /result.oh_military_retirement_deduction xdef { result.military_retirement_income cvd /result.oh_military_retirement_deduction xdef } result.state_calc_resident_status "full_year" streq if " OH Schedule of Adjustments line 34 uniformed services retirement income: $" result.oh_military_retirement_deduction strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.state_calc_agi - result.oh_military_retirement_deduction) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.035
action_details.action_postfix: result.state_calc_agi result.oh_military_retirement_deduction f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.035 fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

policy_statement.policy_description: OH: 3.5% x max(AGI - $0, 0) per Ohio Rev. Code § 5747.02
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "OH: 3.5% x max(AGI - $0, 0) per Ohio Rev. Code § 5747.02"
